findings.ac: AC2 filters, search, modals, deep links function identically
findings.text: Tests only cover useRouting init, nav('directory') and goTo('co-2'), plus a happy-path useEcosystemData fetch. Not proven by any test: the popstate handler (back/forward incl. 404 branch), the pendingDetail deep-link resolution effect for /region/company/slug (found and not found), parseURL cases (universal views, jobDetail, 404), the useEcosystemData mock-data fallback, the no-matching-region landing and single-region redirect branches, and the filter/search/modal logic that stays in App.jsx. The identical-behavior AC is largely unverified by tests.

The issue requires src/hooks/useAppData.js and src/hooks/useDeepLinkRouting.js. The slice instead adds src/useEcosystemData.js and src/useRouting.js (no src/hooks directory). The names and location deviate from the stated spec with no recorded rationale. The PRD only says 'modular hooks', so this is a mismatch with the issue rather than the PRD.

findings.ac: AC1 npm run build completes with zero errors
findings.text: No test or recorded build/CI evidence in the packet proves the build passes with zero errors or warnings (PRD DoD also says zero warnings). The only script change is the added 'test': 'vitest run'. Unverified, not shown failing.

findings.ac: AC3 zero user-facing latency / behavior-neutral extraction
findings.text: No test or measurement covers this AC. The extraction changes behavior slightly: useEcosystemData's load effect deps changed from [] to [regionSlug], and the single-region redirect now checks parseURL().view instead of the App 'view' state. No test covers either change, so strict 1:1 neutrality is unproven.
